title: Remove Transformation section from Home page and add enhanced footer with quick links

requirements.text: Remove the "Your Transformation Starts Here" section from the Home page so it no longer renders anywhere on the / route.

quotes: remove that " your transformation- start here " section fully from the home page

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to the Home page (/) does not display the Transformation section content (including the 'Your Transformation' / 'Starts Here' text).
No empty spacing or visual gaps remain where the section previously appeared.
Build passes with no unused-import TypeScript errors (e.g., TransformationSection is not imported if not used).

requirements.text: Update the site footer to include: (1) the company name, (2) a short description, and (3) quick links to the main website pages (Home, About Us, Courses, Contact Us). Keep styling consistent with the existing cinematic dark luxury theme.

quotes: add a footer to the website which must contact company name , a small description and quick links of the website.

acceptanceCriteria: Footer displays the company name "ZIN SHREYA'S ACADEMY".
Footer includes a short descriptive sentence/paragraph in English.
Footer includes quick links that navigate to: /, /about, /courses, /contact.
Footer renders across all pages via the shared layout (not only on the Home page).
Footer is responsive (links remain usable and readable on mobile and desktop).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Do not introduce new backend services or external databases; this change should be frontend-only.
nonGoals: Do not add new routes/pages beyond the existing Home, About Us, Courses, Contact Us pages.
Do not change Internet Identity/authentication behavior.
Do not add or require any backend canister logic for the footer or homepage sections.
